env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A non-const map in the same positions stays rejected.
cd bad
! logos build ./...
stderr 'array length len\(dyn\) \(value of type int\) must be constant'
stderr 'array length len\(dyn\) \* 2 \+ 1 \(value of type int\) must be constant'
stderr '\[correctness::const_eval\] read of package variable dyn in const func'
cd ..

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/cmlenbad

go 1.27

-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

var dyn = map[int]string{1: "a"}

var _ [len(dyn)]int

var _ = [len(dyn)]int{1}

func take(a [len(dyn)]int) [len(dyn)]int {
	return a
}

type strct struct {
	f [len(dyn)]int
}

type arr [len(dyn)]int

type box[T any] struct {
	v T
}

var _ box[[len(dyn)]int]

var _ [len(dyn)*2 + 1]int

const sh = 1 << len(dyn)

func main() {}
